title: Existence of the evaluation-normalized comparison
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite extension in universe $u$. For each scheme $W$ in universe $u$, use either the positive finite coefficient sheaf $(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1})_W$ at $s=\mathrm{some}(n)$ or the ordinary completed ring sheaf $\varprojlim_n(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1})_W$ at $s=\mathrm{none}$ [lem-pod-reindexing-hom-resolution-model]. Write $D_W$ for its ordinary unbounded module derived category, $F_g$ for the recorded exact reindexing functor, and $H_W$ for the recorded derived Hom. Fix on every scheme in question a closed structure $S_W$ for $H_W$ and its normalized K-flat tensor model $T_W$ [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. Assume $\ell$ is invertible in every residue field of every such scheme, and each pro-etale site is essentially small in universe $u+1$ (its object universe is $u+1$, its arrow universe is $u$, the module universe is $u+1$, and the localization universe is $u+2$). Let $g:X\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$ be a scheme isomorphism. There exists a normalized Comparison $c$ of [def-pod-reindexing-coherence-data] such that for every $M,N\in D_Y$, $c^{\otimes}_{H_Y(M,N),M};(c^H_{M,N}\otimes1);\operatorname{ev}_{F_gM,F_gN}=F_g(\operatorname{ev}_{M,N})$. Here evaluation is the counit of the given closed structure. No uniqueness, transpose or signed-shift law is asserted.

proof.text: Use the product-Hom comparison and derived K-injective model from lem-pod-reindexing-hom-resolution-model. The same degreewise product construction works for arbitrary target complexes, since its chain identity needs only additivity and composition, not K-injectivity. Reindex total-tensor summands on pure tensors and descend on independent K-flat representatives. This constructs all Comparison fields and their prescribed model equations.

Choose flat-term K-flat P and a K-injective I. Apply the one-sided chain-transpose lemma to A=Hom(P,I) and its identity map. The evaluation is f tensor x maps to f(x), followed by inverse localized target augmentation. chain_projection and tensorChain_pure identify the two reindexed maps on every pure generator. Total-tensor and sheafification extensionality give equality of chain maps; localize, cancel the model isomorphisms and use naturality along resolutions to give the equation on arbitrary derived M,N.
